# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## Window Title Bar
- Application name: LibreOffice Impress
- Document name: ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx
- Current date and time: Oct 22 23:18
- System tray icons: Bell icon (notifications), volume control, power button
- Window control buttons: Minimize, Maximize, Close (top-right corner)

## Menu Bar
- Standard menu options: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar
- Primary toolbar with icons for common functions:
  - File operations (New, Open, Save, Print)
  - Object insertion (Images, Charts, Shapes, Tables)
  - Drawing tools (Lines, Arrows, Shapes, Text boxes)
  - Formatting tools (Font, Text alignment, Bullet points)
  - Slide management (Slide layout, Master slide, Slide show controls)
  - Special characters and symbols (Ω, A with accent, etc.)

## Sidebar (Left Panel)
- Slides panel with thumbnails of all 18 slides
- Currently selected slide: Slide 10 of 18
- Slide 10 title: "2. PROGRAMS/SERVICES/MENTORING"
- Slide thumbnails show titles and content previews
- Scroll bar on right side of slides panel

## Main Content Area
- Current slide: Slide 10 of 18
- Slide title: "2. PROGRAMS/SERVICES/MENTORING"
- Slide content:
  - Goal 2.1: Realign existing conferences, meetings, webinars, workshops, and other programs and services to meet more closely the needs of both academics and professionals.
  - Goal 2.2: Provide a more effective conduit between academics and professionals.
  - Goal 2.3: Expand and strengthen programs and services at the local/regional, SIG, and international levels.
  - Goal 2.4: Introduce a variety of mentoring programs for academic and professional leadership.
- Footer text: "asis&t" (logo) and "Association for Information Science and Technology"

## Properties Panel (Right Panel)
- Panel title: Properties
- Section: Slide
  - Format: Widescreen (dropdown)
  - Orientation: Landscape (dropdown)
  - Background: None (dropdown) with "Insert Image..." button
  - Master Slide: Title and Content (dropdown)
    - Master Background: Checked
    - Master Objects: Checked
    - Master View: Button
- Section: Layouts
  - Grid of layout thumbnails (12 total)
  - Layouts show different slide layout options with title and content areas

## Status Bar (Bottom)
- Slide information: "Slide 10 of 18"
- Current layout: "Title and Content"
- Position coordinates: "-4.92 / 20.99"
- Size: "0.00 x 0.00"
- Zoom level: "92%"
- Language: "English (USA)"
- Zoom slider and +/- buttons for zoom control

## Notification Banner (Top)
- Blue banner with two informational messages:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" button
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community." with "Donate" button
- Close button (X) for the banner

## Desktop Environment
- Left dock with application icons:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress (currently active)
  - GIMP
  - File manager
  - App Store
  - Help icon (?)
  - Trash icon
- Bottom dock with grid icon for application launcher

## Additional UI Elements
- Scroll bars for slides panel and properties panel
- Tabbed interface for properties panel
- Settings gear icon in properties panel
- Three-line menu icon in properties panel
- Zoom control in status bar
- Language indicator in status bar
- Page number indicator in status bar
- Slide number indicator in status bar
